message:
feat: integrate stack metadata into commit lifecycle

WHY
Commit entries lacked stack context (stack ID and branch) during persistence, log parsing, and atomic operations, leading to loss of relationship information between stacked commits.

WHAT
* Added stackID and stackBranch fields to commit entry configuration and metadata.
* Updated CommitStore serialization to include stack metadata in the JSONL filesystem store.
* Implemented stack identifier capture during git log processing via merge-base SHA and branch name.
